title: Grilled Beef Bistek with German Twist
description: A traditional Filipino dish with a German twist, featuring grilled beef, onions, and a tangy sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced onions and cook until they're caramelized, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
4. Add the beef bistek and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
5. In a small bowl, mix together the tomato paste, beef broth, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
6. Pour the sauce over the beef and onions, and stir to coat.
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
